basic_details.organization_name: Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati (IIT Guwahati)

qualification.education_qualification: M.E./ M.Tech in EEE/ ECE/ EE or relevant, B.E./ B.Tech with GATE/ NET + experience, PhD with thesis submitted
qualification.details: SRF(Direct)-1: M.E./ M.Tech in EEE/ ECE/ EE or B.E./ B.Tech in EEE/ ECE/ EE with GATE/ NET Score/ Other National Exams + 2yrs of research exp. Experience in Analog IC Design, Chip Measurements and PCB Testing is highly desirable. SRF(Direct)-2: M.E./ M.Tech/ MSc in EEE/ ECE/ Nanotechnology/ Electronics/ Physics or other relevant disciplines with GATE/ NET Score/ Other National Exams + 2yrs of research Exp. OR PhD candidates with Thesis submitted in relevant disciplines. Candidate with expertise in Spintronics/ Nanoelectronics/ Device fabrication/ Cleanroom experience/ High Frequency device measurement / Micromagnetic or COMSOL Multiphysics simulation / Labview based system integration, is desirable. SRF(Direct)-3: M.E./ M.Tech / B.E./ B.Tech in EEE/ ECE/ Nanotechnology/ Electronics or other relevant disciplines with GATE/ NET Score/ Other National Exams+ 2yrs of research Exp. OR PhD candidates with Thesis submitted in relevant disciplines. Candidate with expertise in Sensors (electrochemical/ TFT/ FET) development and its prototyping, Material Synthesis and Characterization, Signal conditioning circuit is desirable. Associate Project Engineer-1: M.E./ M.Tech in EEE/ ECE/ EE OR B.E./ B.Tech in EEE/ ECE/ EE + 3yrs of research exp. Experience in Analog IC Design, Chip Measurements and PCB Testing is highly desirable. Associate Project Engineer-3: M.E./ M.Tech/ MSc in EEE/ ECE/ Nanotechnology/ Physics/ Electronics or other relevant disciplines OR B.E./ B.Tech/ BSc in EEE/ ECE/ Electronics/ Physics or other relevant disciplines+ 3 yrs Exp. Candidate with knowledge in Antenna/ Wireless Communication/ CST/ HFSS/ Mixed Signal Design is desirable.

selection_process: Online Interview Shortlisting via Email Performance in Interview
how_to_apply: Applications must be submitted online on or before 17-08-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Guwahati to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online on or before 17-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Guwahati to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIT Guwahati Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the SRF(Direct) and Associate Project Engineer posts at IIT Guwahati is 17 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies announced for the SRF(Direct) and Associate Project Engineer positions at IIT Guwahati.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: The eligibility criteria include M.E./M.Tech or B.E./B.Tech with GATE/NET and relevant experience, or PhD with thesis submitted, depending on the specific post.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for IIT Guwahati Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the SRF and Associate Project Engineer roles?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs. 43,660 to Rs. 49,560 per month, depending on the specific post and qualifications.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for these positions?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting candidates via email, followed by an online interview based on performance.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for IIT Guwahati Recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted online through the official website or the provided application link.

faq.question: Q8. Where is IIT Guwahati located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati is located in Guwahati, Assam, with the pincode 781039.

faq.question: Q9. Are there any age relaxations mentioned for reserved categories?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify age limits or relaxations. Candidates are advised to check the detailed advertisement.

faq.question: Q10. When will shortlisted candidates be informed?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates will be informed via email on 19 August 2026.
